tools.description: Scan a file's text for PolinRider / Contagious Interview malware traits before installing, building, or running it. Static only — the file is never executed, and the text is scanned in memory and never stored. Returns verdict clean/suspicious/dangerous, a 0-100 score, action allow/review/block, and the traits found.

content.description: Full file text to scan. Max 2 MB.

tools.name: malware_scan

tools.description: Scan a whole downloaded/cloned folder (up to 100 files) for PolinRider / Contagious Interview malware traits in one call, before installing, building, or running anything in it. Static only — files are never executed, all scanning is in memory, nothing is stored. Returns one verdict for the folder (clean/suspicious/dangerous), a 0-100 score, action allow/review/block, and which files flagged.

files.description: Files to scan, each with filename and full text content. Max 100 files, 2 MB per file, 10 MB total.

tools.name: malware_scan_batch

tools.description: Scan a PUBLIC GitHub repo for PolinRider / Contagious Interview malware before cloning it for use. The server clones the repo into a temp folder, scans the working tree and every commit's config files, deletes the whole clone, and returns the verdict. Public repos only — no tokens, no private repos, nothing stored. Returns verdict clean/suspicious/dangerous, a 0-100 score, action allow/review/block, and the traits found, including which history commits were infected.
tools.name: malware_scan_repo
